clues: This town is the most peopled in its state. It stands on a river, face to face with a town in the land to the north.
In winter the cold is hard: most years bring six weeks of days that never rise past the freeze point. Summers turn warm to hot.
In 1701, men from France built a fort on this river bank. That fort was the seed of this town.
In 2013 this town went broke, the most big town in its land to do so. It climbed back out the next year.
Cars made this town: in the early 1900s its car works grew it to the fourth most peopled town in its land.
